cases.name: Mary Jane Spears
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Mary was a beautiful soul who graced this earth for too short of a time. Mary was a beloved and devoted Mother first and foremost, Sister, Daughter and Aunt. 

Mary lived a life full of love, adventure and compassion. There wasn’t a single person that Mary met that didn’t instantly love her. She lit up any room she walked in to. Mary graduated from Lamar High School in Arlington, TX. She had been recently attending online classes at Tarrant County College, where she had obtained her associates degree and was just a semester away from earning her bachelor's degree before she was taken too soon from life.

She was a very hard and devoted worker where she spent the last 10 years as an office manager for J Perez and associates in Grapevine, TX.

Mary loved animals. She would volunteer Friday nights at PetSmart to feed and play with the adoptable cats. She was constantly finding cats to foster and rehome, always feeding the neighborhood cats even when she had two of her own. Mary was just an all-around selfless human being. She would always tell you her greatest accomplishment in life was being a mom to her three children."
cases.narrative: The morning of the murder, Mr. Spears sent a concerning text message to one of Ms. Spears’ family members. That family member went looking for her and found her unresponsive in the backyard with multiple stab wounds.
